name: Florence
tagline: 150-year-old bistecca alla fiorentina, and the shared tables where lunch has cost 15 euros since the 1950s.

Trattoria Sostanza.description: The temple of bistecca alla fiorentina for more than 150 years, in San Frediano.

Trattoria Mario.description: Shared tables and a fixed menu since the 1950s, Florence's most famous lunch trattoria.

Buca Lapi.description: A century-old cellar under the Palazzo Antinori, birthplace of the Tuscan bistecca. Bib Gourmand.

Borgo San Jacopo.description: On the Arno, with a direct view of the Ponte Vecchio. High-precision Italian cuisine from chef Claudio Mengoni. One Michelin star.

La Leggenda dei Frati.description: Inside the Villa Bardini complex, with panoramic views of Florence. Tuscan-rooted cuisine from chef Filippo Saporito. One Michelin star.
